SCOPE OF WORK Fabrication and supply of Box type Anode Substrates (500x300x31 mm) made out of p ure Titanium (ASTM B265 Gr.2) sheet expanded mesh and Titanium tubes with mesh co vering, as per Drawing No APEP/TMAS/2026/002 and General terms & conditions descri bed below. i. Seamless Ti tubes will be supplied by APEP/VSSC as free issue material. About 102 m ± 5% of Titanium tube (in approx. length of 3 m/ piece) required for the fabrication of Anode Sub strate will be supplied by the department subject to submission of bank guarante e (of approx. amount Rs 1.5 lakhs) by the party valid till the acceptance of last lo t of fabricated Anode substrates at APEP. ii. On receipt of PO, party shall immediately collect the Titanium tubes (mentioned above) fro m APEP/ VSSC, Aluva to their site at their expenses. Loading at APEP will be arranged by the Department. iii. Balance Titanium tubes shall be returned back to APEP with the material consumption repor t during the delivery of final lot of anode substrates. iv. Remaining components like Titanium mesh, Titanium flange etc., required for the fabricatio n are to be procured by the party. Fabrication shall be carried out by the party at their site a s per Drawing No APEP/TMAS/2026/002 and supplied to APEP/ VSSC, Aluva. A. Titanium Mesh - Specifications: 1. The Titanium mesh shall be of sheet expanded type &specification as follows: 1. Titanium sheet (min. thickness of 1.5 mm) is simultaneously slit and stretched, expanding t he slits into diamond shaped holes of uniform size, shape and regularity to yield mesh thick ness of 2.8 – 3.0 mm. 2. Mesh opening dimensions: long width opening (LW) shall be 8-9 mm and short width openin g (SW) shall be 4-5 mm. 3. Dimension of the titanium mesh is very important for the fabrication of the anode. The shee t shall be of pure Titanium and conforming to ASTM Grade 2 2. The sheet expanded titanium mesh should not be flattened during mesh opening operation or after mesh opening or during fabrication of substrates. Anode substrates are to be fabric ated with the mesh having wavy surface. 3. While fabrication of anode, box mesh should be joined by welding all the mesh contact poin ts on the titanium tube by keeping the surface geometry and parallelism as per the drawing attached. 4. Maximum 2 pieces of titanium mesh shall be used for fabrication of Box. 5. The sheet expanded titanium mesh used for anode fabrication should be free from all kinds of burs, breakages, sharp edges & corners. B. Titanium Tube-Specifications: 1. Seamless Titanium tubes supplied by VSSC (Type: Titanium Gr-2, Total Length: about 102 m ) shall only be used for fabrication. 2. The bottom end of Titanium tube shall be closed with pure Titanium sheet (ASTM Grade 2) o f 2.0 mm thickness. Ensure leak proof welding. 3. The external surfaces of all the titanium tubes, up to the flange level including closed botto m, should have titanium mesh covering all-round. Mesh shall be welded to the respective tu be sides without fouling the main mesh box. The mesh for covering the tube shall be shape d suitably before welding. Specifications of the mesh for covering the tube shall also confor m to mesh used for making the anode box which is mentioned earlier. C. Welding Titanium Mesh with Titanium Tube:

C. Welding Titanium Mesh with Titanium Tube: 1. TIG welding method shall be adopted for all welding. Welding shall be done at all contact po ints of mesh and the tube on both sides using pure titanium filler rods. 2. The orientation of the titanium mesh opening shall be strictly as per drawing i.e., SW of the mesh should be parallel to the axis of the titanium tube and the LW perpendicular to the axi s of the titanium tube so as to ensure maximum number of weld contacts between mesh a nd the titanium tube. 3. All titanium welding shall be carried out in controlled atmosphere to prevent the oxidation in weld area. Projections, excess weld deposits, puncturing of tube at weld points etc., are to b e strictly avoided. D. Numbering of Anode substrates Anodes shall be given unique identification number showing year of manufacture. (eg:- Co mpany name short form/Sl No/Year). This shall be punched legibly in Titanium flange of on e leg of the anode substrate II. INSPECTION: A. Inspection of raw materials: - Titanium Sheets, Titanium Mesh and welding rod. 1. Party shall send Titanium Sheet (for mesh, flange& tube closure), Titanium welding rod sam ples which shall be used for fabricating anodes to APEP for analysis and inspection. 2. Test certificate from a Govt approved laboratory for the material quality is to be provided wi th the samples. 3. Test result will be communicated to the party and the Titanium sheet expansion works are t o be commenced only after getting clearance from VSSC. 4. After expanding the Titanium sheet, party has to send the samples of expanded mesh to AP EP for dimensional clearance. Clearance of the Titanium mesh from APEP is mandatory for s ample anode fabrication. Maximum of 2 nos of mesh sample submission will only be allowe d. B. Sample Fabrication: 1. Up on getting clearance of the raw materials as mentioned in (II A), party has to intimate, wi thin 2 weeks, the readiness for work initiation to APEP/VSSC. All items for fabrication of entir e 102 nos ( ie Ti sheet, Ti mesh, welding rods, fixtures) should be available at party’s site a nd shall be inspected by APEP staff during this visit. PO will be short closed if party fails to s ubmit the same to APEP staff coming for inspection. Party has to start the fabrication of sam ple anodes (2 Nos) in presence of APEP staff. Minor improvements, if any, suggested by the APEP staff shall be incorporated by the party free of cost 2. Two sample Anodes that are fabricated, has to be supplied to APEP for clearance. Party sho uld ensure that the dimensions and finish should be as per the drawing submitted. Any sha rp edge in the mesh edges should be removed .Clearance of sample anodes from APE P/VSSC in writing is mandatory to start the bulk fabrication. If the sample anode submitted by party is not found acceptable/ meeting specifications, party will be given one more chance to resubmit 2 nos. of sample anodes. If the second set of sample anodes are not as per specification, PO shall be short closed. C. Pre-delivery Inspection(prior to each lot): Following test/checks has to be performed by the party at their site and test reports contai ning the anode number to be submitted before despatch of the anodes to APEP.VSSC will d epute inspection team at any stages of bulk fabrication to assess the status of work. Party has to coordinate the inspection on intimation from VSSC. 1. Leak Testing: All titanium tubes are to be Pressure tested (Hydro-test) at 15 psig to confirm leak proof of the titanium tubes after completion of welding and all other fabrication proces ses as per the drawing.

2. Dimensional inspection: Party has to verify and report all the dimensions mentioned in the f abrication drawing. II. DELIVERY SCHEDULE: 1. Raw materials for inspection & testing (Titanium Sheets, welding rod and welding rod) sh all be supplied to APEP, Aluva within 1 month from the date of PO. 2. Expansion of sheets and submission of samples (sheet expanded mesh) to APEP for clear ance shall be done within 1 month of raw material clearance. 3. Sample fabrication readiness: To be intimated within 2 weeks from acceptance of expand ed mesh. 4. Bulk fabrication: Bulk fabrication shall be commenced only after the approval of sample a nodes. Supply shall be in 2 lots, First lot of 50 Nos shall be supplied within 2 months from th e date of acceptance of sample anode. Second lot of 50 anodes shall be supplied within 4 m onths from the date of acceptance of sample anode. III. PAYMENT Payment shall be made on pro rata basis on receipt, testing and acceptance of the item at APEP. II. GUARANTEE Supplied item shall be guaranteed for a minimum period of one year II. ELIGIBILITY CRITERIA 1. Documentary evidence of previous experience of the party ( at least 2 Nos) in supplying sim ilar Titanium mesh anodes to be submitted along with the bid. Offer without submitting the previous experience will not be considered. 2. Acceptance of attached drawing with seal and signature to be submitted along with the bid. 3. Acceptance of annexure 1 with seal and signature to be submitted along with the bid. .
